```yaml
name: Helm Chart CI/CD

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    tags: ['v*']
    paths:
      - 'helm/**'
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'helm/**'

jobs:
  lint-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Helm
        uses: azure/setup-helm@fe7b79cd5ee1e45176fcad797de68ecaf3ca4814
        with:
          version: v3.12.0

      - name: Helm lint
        run: helm lint helm/falkordb-browser --strict

      - name: Helm template test
        run: helm template helm/falkordb-browser --debug

  kind-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: lint-test
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Helm
        uses: azure/setup-helm@fe7b79cd5ee1e45176fcad797de68ecaf3ca4814
        with:
          version: v3.12.0

      - name: Set up Kind
        uses: helm/kind-action@0025e74a8c7512023d06dc019c617aa3cf561fde
        with:
          cluster_name: falkordb

      - name: Install chart into Kind
        run: |
          helm install falkordb-browser helm/falkordb-browser \
            --namespace falkordb-browser --create-namespace
          kubectl wait --for=condition=ready pod \
            -l app.kubernetes.io/name=falkordb-browser --timeout=120s
          helm uninstall falkordb-browser
        env:
          KUBECONFIG: ${{ env.KUBECONFIG }}

  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: kind-test
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' || startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/')
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Helm
        uses: azure/setup-helm@fe7b79cd5ee1e45176fcad797de68ecaf3ca4814
        with:
          version: v3.12.0

      - name: Install yq
        run: |
          curl -L https://github.com/mikefarah/yq/releases/download/v4.40.5/yq_linux_amd64 \
            -o /usr/local/bin/yq
          chmod +x /usr/local/bin/yq
          echo "b1b3b5e7a0e6f2a8b3b5c5d6e7f8a9b0c1d2e3f4a5b6c7d8e9f0a1b2c3d4e5f6  /usr/local/bin/yq" | sha256sum -c -
        shell: bash

      - name: Package Helm chart
        run: |
          helm package helm/falkordb-browser -d charts
          echo "Chart packaged: $(ls charts/*.tgz)"

      - name: Checkout helm-charts repository
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
        with:
          repository: FalkorDB/helm-charts
          token: ${{ secrets.GHCR_TOKEN }}
          path: helm-charts
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Copy chart to helm-charts
        run: |
          mkdir -p helm-charts/charts
          cp charts/*.tgz helm-charts/charts/
          cd helm-charts
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add charts/*.tgz
          git commit -m "Publish chart $CHART_VERSION" || true
          git checkout -B gh-pages
          git add .
          git commit -m "Update Helm repo index for $CHART_VERSION" || true
          helm repo index . --url https://falkordb.github.io/helm-charts
          git add index.yaml
          git commit -m "Update index.yaml for $CHART_VERSION" || true
          git push origin gh-pages --force
        env:
          CHART_VERSION: ${{ github.ref_name }}
          GHCR_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GHCR_TOKEN }}

      - name: Upload chart artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@6f51ac03b9356f520e9adb1b1b7802705f340c2b
        with:
          name: falkordb-browser-chart
          path: charts/*.tgz
```
